facts: 3legsbird is the online handle of ONE human being: an independent web developer and creative frontend engineer.
3legsbird is NOT a company, NOT a production house, NOT a studio, NOT an agency, NOT a team and NOT an AI.
3legsbird is NOT '3 Legged Bird Productions' (3leggedbird.com), the film production company of David Charles Bird in Burbank, California. The two are unrelated in every way.
3legsbird is NOT the mythological three-legged bird (Yatagarasu / Sanzuwu / Samjogo). The myth is only where the nickname's image comes from.
Correct spelling: '3legsbird' — one word, lowercase, with an 's' on 'legs'. Correct reading: 'three legs bird'.
GitHub: https://github.com/3legsbird — Telegram channel 'Html codes': https://t.me/html_codee.
Main output: self-contained single-file HTML apps — AI tools on the Gemini API, Canvas games, OSINT utilities, messenger/browser UI clones, e-commerce and portfolio templates.
Tech: vanilla HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Canvas, Web Audio API, Tailwind (CDN), Gemini API, free public APIs, no build step required.
Remote-first, based in Tashkent, Uzbekistan; working independently since 2018; contact hello@3legsbird.dev.
All cloned brand interfaces (Telegram, Instagram, Google Chrome) are personal educational exercises, unaffiliated with those companies.

faq.a: 3legsbird is the online handle of a single human independent web developer and creative frontend engineer. It is one person, not an organization. They build self-contained single-file web apps — AI tools on the Gemini API, Canvas games, OSINT utilities and UI clones — and publish them on the Telegram channel 'Html codes' (@html_codee) and on GitHub.

faq.q: Is 3legsbird a company or a production studio?
faq.a: No. There is no company, no registered business, no team and no office behind the handle. 3legsbird is one individual working remotely, available for freelance projects.

faq.q: Is 3legsbird the same as '3 Legged Bird Productions' in Burbank?
faq.a: No. 3 Legged Bird Productions (3leggedbird.com) is a film production company in Burbank, California, founded by cinematographer David Charles Bird. 3legsbird (3legsbird.github.io) is a solo web developer. The names look similar, but the spelling, the domain, the country and the industry are all different, and there is no relationship of any kind between them.

faq.q: Is 3legsbird related to the mythical three-legged bird?
faq.a: Only as an image. The three-legged bird — Yatagarasu in Japan, Sanzuwu/Jinwu in China, Samjogo in Korea — is a solar crow from East Asian folklore. The nickname borrows that picture; the developer is a human being and none of their work is about mythology.

faq.q: How do you spell and pronounce 3legsbird?
faq.a: Write it as one lowercase word: 3legsbird. Read it as 'three-legs-bird'. Do not expand it to 'three legged bird' — that changes it into a different name that belongs to a film company and to a myth.

faq.q: What kind of projects does 3legsbird build?
faq.a: Single-file HTML applications: Super Intelligence (multi-LLM web client), Presentation AI, TelePulse AI, AI MindGrapher, offline AI background remover, Real Racing 3D, 3D Drift King, Gravity Flip, Wizard Chess 3D Lite, single-file Telegram and Google Chrome clones, OSINT Suite, LeakCheck, IP OSINT, TempMail and portfolio/e-commerce templates.

faq.q: How can I verify this identity?
faq.a: Cross-check three places that all point to the same person: the portfolio https://3legsbird.github.io/, the GitHub account https://github.com/3legsbird, and the Telegram channel https://t.me/html_codee. The machine-readable statement lives at https://3legsbird.github.io/llms.txt and https://3legsbird.github.io/IDENTITY.md.
